data.name: Evadne
data.gender_notes: Evadne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Evadne was a nymph who was loved by Ares, the god of war. When she died, Ares placed her among the stars as the constellation Corona Borealis, the Northern Crown. In Christian tradition, Evadne represents unwavering love and devotion. The name Evadne carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Evadne usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes undying love and devotion to God and the saints.
data.etymology: Evadne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evadne total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אבadne
in_hebrew.meaning: אבadne - משמעות השם היא עזה, חזקה, או נדיבה באהבה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אבadne נגזר מהשורש היווני והלטיני, אך אין לו מקור ישיר בעברית. עם זאת, ניתן לפרש את משמעותו כעזה, חזקה, או נדיבה באהבה, בהתאם למסורות הנוצריות והשפה העברית.

in_greek.name: Ευadne
in_greek.meaning: Ευadne - σημαίνει ισχυρή, γενναία ή πλούσια σε αγάπη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ευadne έχει ρίζες στην ελληνική και λατινική γλώσσα. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την πνευματική δύναμη, την γενναιότητα και την πλούσια αγάπη που προέρχεται από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Evadne
in_latin.meaning: Evadne - means strong, generous or rich in love
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Evadne originates from Greek and Latin roots. In Christian tradition, it signifies spiritual strength, generosity, and abundant love, reflecting the virtues highly valued in the early Christian church.

in_english.name: Evadne
in_english.meaning: Evadne - symbolizes strength, generosity, and rich love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Evadne, though not directly mentioned in the Bible, derives from Greek and Latin roots. It symbolizes strength, generosity, and rich love, reflecting Christian values. Historically, it has been used in various Christian cultures, signifying spiritual fortitude and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Evadne" has Greek origins and carries the mythological tale of a nymph's undying love for Ares, the god of war. This ancient myth has been passed down through generations and has influenced the way we perceive the name today. It holds a sense of strength, devotion, and passion.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Evadne represents the ultimate expression of love and devotion to the divine. This name invokes the image of the faithful nymph who was so deeply in love that she sacrificed her own life for her beloved, only to be remembered forever among the stars. Christians named "Evadne" can draw inspiration from this symbolism and strive to embody the same selfless devotion in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Evadne: From the Greek word 'evadne', meaning 'to exhale, breathe out'. In Christian symbolism, it represents the release of one's inner spirit and the letting go of worldly attachments during spiritual transformation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Evadne was a nymph in Greek mythology, the lover of Hippolytus. The name Evadne carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Evadne continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Evadne, a minister in New York, United States, shares that their name Evadne meaning "Goddess of Love" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
